pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions on the flank with moderate edge gradients. Patch area is largest on the upper flank and neck, transitioning to smaller, more rounded geometries toward the posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of narrow, light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial with a high degree of connectivity. Pixel thickness of corridors is relatively uniform across the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the cervical-dorsal transition against the background.
